verdict: Strongly toward the stop: at 2R the target has to come first in 33 % of the replays that hit one side; it did in 15 % (target first 3.3 % vs stop first 19.2 %).

note: A simulation built from SLB's own last 59 full sessions. It is not a prediction: earnings, news and halts can do things those sessions never did. Same seed, same numbers.
